capabilities: preview suggestions by holding Alt/Option before selecting them
preview file, heading and block link suggestions
preview suggestions in the quick switcher and Quick switcher++
preview note and media suggestions in Canvas
expose an API so other plugins can add preview to custom suggesters
extras: Installation via BRAT for beta releases is documented; development is supported through Buy Me a Coffee; other plugins can integrate via the exposed API.
problem: Obsidian's quick switcher and link suggestions only show file names, so you must select an item before you can see what is inside it.
summary: Preview plugin that shows a note preview while holding a modifier key on suggestions in link suggestions, the quick switcher, and canvas.
